description: This file defines the `HiringManagerUserRole` class, which manages access control for different entity types related to recruitment and HR processes within the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on the hiring manager's permissions and entity types

classes.name: HiringManagerUserRole
classes.description: A class extending AbstractUserRole, providing methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs for a hiring manager based on permissions and entity type

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of accessible entity IDs for the specified entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy attachment IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachment IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate action history IDs accessible to the hiring manager.
